resource_definitions.qeli_cpu_percent: Sum of retained Qeli process CPU ticks divided by elapsed wall time; 100% is one vCPU, possible 200% on this two-vCPU guest.
resource_definitions.vm_busy_percent: Host-wide non-idle, non-iowait, non-steal guest CPU fraction; 100% is all assigned vCPUs.
resource_definitions.qeli_peak_sampled_rss_kib: Peak sum of sampled RSS across retained Qeli processes; shared pages may be counted more than once.
resource_definitions.tun_tx_drops: Interface TX dropped delta, not a traced FULL_RING count. Baseline observes eth1; perf observes the test TUN. Includes observer warm-up/tail.
resource_definitions.udp_sndbuf_errors: Guest-wide SNMP counter delta, not socket-specific attribution.
